abstract: A 24-year-old male with mixed germ cell tumor after orchiectomy received chemotherapy for abdominal and thoracic lymphadenopathy. Follow-up imaging revealed residual disease in the retroperitoneum as well as thrombus within his inferior vena cava. At surgery, the mass was palpable within the inferior vena cava. After vascular control both proximal and distal to the intraluminal mass, a cavotomy allowed extraction of the thrombus. Final pathologic evaluation of the mass revealed mature teratoma. The surgeon must remain vigilant to the possibility of caval thrombus and be prepared for surgical removal in the cases of advanced germ cell tumors.
abstract_ja: 24歳男性が精巣摘除術後に混合型胚細胞腫瘍と診断され、腹部および胸部リンパ節腫大に対して化学療法を受けた。フォローアップ画像検査で後腹膜の残存病変と下大静脈内の腫瘍栓が明らかになった。手術では、腫瘍の口側と尾側で血管を確保した後、大静脈切開により腫瘍栓を摘出した。最終的な病理検査で腫瘤は成熟奇形腫と判明した。外科医は大静脈内の腫瘍栓の可能性に注意を払い、進行した胚細胞腫瘍の症例では外科的切除に備えておく必要がある。
